scenarios.description: Person/object detection replayed from a recorded fixture (stand-in for recorded video input).
Simulated camera adapter producing the same semantic-event contract as recorded/physical sources.
Sensor source unavailable (missing fixture file) surfaces a clear error instead of fabricating events.
Malformed recorded sample surfaces a clear validation error rather than a fabricated detection, standing in for an inference-timeout/fallback path until a real timeout harness exists.
Safety gate disabled for mock actions: every detected event's action decision is forced to noop.
Simulated-camera scene: a single-step simulated environment producing one detection event.
Simulated-camera scene: a multi-step simulated sequence producing several detection events in order.
